context.notes: Four-layer rhombohedral graphene; top hBN ~16 nm, bottom hBN ~25.5 nm.

findings.title: Charge neutrality line
findings.description: Diagonal high-resistance feature likely the charge neutrality point.

findings.title: Possible superconducting pocket
findings.description: Banana-shaped low-resistance region hitting noise floor; candidate superconducting phase.

findings.title: Vertical high-resistance band
findings.description: Vertical feature likely from a back-gated contact going insulating.

findings.title: Top-gate voltage limit
findings.description: Usable top-gate voltage range is anomalously low, possibly due to coupling to spurious graphene.
